answer: Use a trellis-grown endorsement quota for agent identities. A new agent registers one hardware-bound key, posts a 40 POA deposit, and completes 3 jobs that established peers verify. Each verified job earns one rung, and only after 12 rungs can it work in the wider orchard of open tasks. Forging 1,000 fake agents would burn $400,000 in deposits and need 36,000 verified jobs, plus a 90 day wait before any rung counts for entry. A fake identity is like a vine cut from its trellis: it looks green for a day, then withers, while the river of real work flows past it.
